newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Davao Union 10-mth net at 435 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Davao Union 10-mth net at 435 mln pesos.

text.p: Davao Union Cement Corp said on Tuesday it made an unaudited 435 million peso net income for the first 10 months of its fiscal year ending April 1997.

The company did not give comparative figures but Davao Union treasurer Eduardo Sahagun told reporters the amount exceeded the 340 million pesos income of the company for its full 1995-1996 fiscal year.
Shareholders at its special meeting approved a rise in authorised capital to three billion pesos from two billion.
The increase will be in the form of preferred stocks but no pre-emptive rights will be given to existing shareholders. The preferred stocks will be sold through private placement.
Davao Union is a subsidiary of Bacnotan Consolidated Industries Inc.
